module: Node "Set Ignition" (category `repeat_instant`). Sets the ignition level: `core_vehicleBridge.executeAction(veh,'setIgnitionLevel', mode)`. `mode`: 0 off, 1 accessories, 2 ignition on, 3 starter. Input pins: `vehId`, `mode`. To read the level, use "Get Electrics Value".

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

postInit.desc: Defines the templates of `mode` (Off, Accessory Mode, Ignition On, Starter On).
